messages:
alice: Heads-up — we're seeing a 503 spike from embeddings in eu-west1 after yesterday's model rollout. Error rate jumped ~6%. kvcache OOMs in the logs. Need an expedited hotfix and pin.

deploy-bot: Incident INC-7892 created by alice. Canary failure rate: 15% -> auto-alert.

ben: Oncall — looking at logs now. Can you confirm which model/binary we should pin to?

carla: Proposal: pin back to gpt-embed-1.1.4 (pre-quant-change) and deploy a staged canary — EU only first. Given traffic, recommend skipping global full canary until EU validated. :thumbsup:

dave: SRE here — we need explicit approval from eng + product for skipping global canary. Also need rollback criteria and a circuit-breaker at 1% 5xx.

alice: Patch built and tested locally. Image: sha256:abcd1234. Deploy command (ops):
```
/deploy ml-embed-service --image=sha256:abcd1234 --pin-version=1.1.4-hotfix --staged-canary=eu-west1:10 --hold-for-ops
```

deploy-bot: Waiting on approvals: @carla @dave @ben. Please add :thumbsup: to approve expedited path.

carla: +1 approve. Product notified and OK with EU-first staged canary.

dave: SRE approves. I'll enable circuit-breaker and keep watch on autoscaler. Monitoring hooks in place.

ben: Oncall approves — go ahead. I'll keep a live watch and run quick health checks.

alice: Kicking off deploy now. Will post canary metrics.

deploy-bot: Deploy started for ml-embed-service (1.1.4-hotfix) — canary 10% in eu-west1. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/incidents/INC-7892

alice: 5m check — canary stable, 5xx down to baseline, latency unchanged. Rolling to 50% global over 20m window.

ben: If errors creep above 1% or latency +30% signal, we rollback immediately. Ops standby.

carla: Release note draft: "hotfix: revert kv-cache tweak causing embedding 503s; pinned to 1.1.4-hotfix; staged EU canary then global roll." I'll add to changelog.

dave: Monitoring steady. Circuit-breaker ok. Will trigger rollback if threshold hit.

alice: Rollout at 100% complete. Closing incident after additional 30m observation. Thanks team. :tada:
